title: Launch gate: milestone timeline, scope-lock checklist, and cut criteria for API/Console/Runtime
creator: Alex Chen
description: Coordinate a synchronized launch across Redwood API (hosted), Console observability changes, and runtime (serving) improvements. Deliverables: milestone timeline with explicit scope-lock dates, binary cut criteria for features, a consolidated release notes draft and ownership matrix, and a cross-team GTM checklist (docs, SDKs, support runbooks, partner comms). Primary goals: remove ambiguity on what ships in the train, ensure engineering/QA/design sign-off windows are respected, and minimize post-launch regressions through mandatory gating and fallbacks.
milestones: Milestone 2: Docs & release notes first draft due - 2026-03-17
Milestone 4: Scope lock / cutoff (no new non-critical features) - 2026-03-24
Milestone 5: Final release notes & GTM signoff - 2026-03-26
cut_criteria: No new feature PRs merged after scope lock without explicit PM+Eng lead approval
All P0/P1 regressions must be resolved or have a documented rollback plan before cutoff
Performance SLO: 95th percentile latency for API generation under baseline load must not regress >15% vs baseline
End-to-end Console flows (route dashboards, rollout toggles) must pass smoke tests in staging
Runtime must provide runtime-fallback config for incompatible kernels/models before release
scope_exceptions: Security patches and urgent infra fixes allowed after scope lock with security_review_required: true
Localizations and copy tweaks under 1 hour review may be merged with design + PM notification
release_notes_plan: Owner: Documentation guild (lead: Hannah Lee) - consolidate sections for API, Console, Runtime
Structure: TL;DR + notable changes + migration notes + known issues + SDK changes
Draft cadence: initial draft by 2026-03-17, engineering review 2026-03-19, legal/security review 2026-03-22
Public release notes to be staged on docs.redwood.ai and included in in-console banner for 2 weeks
gtm_tasks: SDK team: publish client library compatibility matrix and bump SDK changelog entries (owner: Miguel Ramos)
Developer Experience: add quickstart example for new streaming API flags (owner: Sita Rao)
Support: update runbook with rollback steps and known-limits (owner: Jake Martinez)
Sales/CS: share feature one-pagers and hosting/upgrade impacts for Dedicated customers (owner: Katrina Wu)
Product Marketing: prepare release announcement email, blog post outline, and PR deck (owner: Ben Strauss)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Late-performance regression in runtime kernel selection - Mitigation: freeze kernel changes 48h before cutoff and enable fallback to previous kernel
Risk: Mismatched Console schemas causing frontend errors - Mitigation: automated contract tests and a canary cohort for 5% of users
Risk: Incomplete release notes causing support churn - Mitigation: required release-notes checklist item in PR template and signoff from Docs lead
acceptance_criteria: All milestone checklist items marked done in project board by 2026-03-26
Release notes published and linked in console banner before rollout
Cross-functional GTM owners have confirmed readiness in the final signoff meeting
Rollback plan verified by on-call and SRE leads and attached to release ticket
